examples.target: 在拐角左转。火车站就在银行旁边。
examples.en: Turn left at the corner. The station is next to the bank.

examples.target: 然后呢？我是左转还是右转？
examples.en: And then? Do I turn left or right?

examples.target: 不远。一直走，过两个路口就到了。
examples.en: No, it is not far. Go straight ahead for two streets.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 打扰一下，需要帮忙吗？你好像迷路了。
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can I help you? You look lost.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 是的，麻烦你。火车站在哪里？远不远？
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Where is the station? Is it far?

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 不远。一直走，过两个路口就到了。
dialogue.en: No, it is not far. Go straight ahead for two streets.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 然后呢？我是左转还是右转？
dialogue.en: And then? Do I turn left or right?

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: 在拐角左转。火车站就在银行旁边。
dialogue.en: Turn left at the corner. The station is next to the bank.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 太谢谢你了！我手机上有地图，所以很容易找。
dialogue.en: Thank you! I have a map on my phone, so it will be easy.
